settings.source: scripts/opus-sf/voice/w7/lines.ts (the unrecorded BAYBAY lines of waves 5-7, retakes of wave-6 clips)

w5-a-760e436e.zh: 我先发球！轮到你时，等影子变金色就点它～
w5-a-760e436e.en: I’ll serve! On your turn, tap the shadow when it turns gold!

w5-a-e5c9d3d8.en: Still high — let it come down!

w5-a-8be2fa97.zh: 呜呼——飞起来啦！插小旗的就是坡顶！
w5-a-8be2fa97.en: Woohoo — we flew! The pennants mark the crests!

w5-a-d6da08f3.zh: 全城 12 个坡顶都飞过啦！
w5-a-d6da08f3.en: All 12 crests in the city — hopped!

w5-a-4a04af8b.zh: 九曲花街的路牌建议每小时 5 英里——慢慢开，别碰到花坛！
w5-a-4a04af8b.en: Lombard’s sign says 5 mph — nice and slow, mind the flower beds!

w5-a-baa3f3d8.zh: 佛蒙特街只有 7 个弯，可坡更陡——慢一点！
w5-a-baa3f3d8.en: Vermont has seven bends but a steeper hill — slowly!

w5-a-4a24dc9b.zh: 九曲花街这一段有 8 个急弯，而且只能往下开哦！
w5-a-4a24dc9b.en: Eight hairpins on this block — and it’s one way, downhill!

w5-a-c3fe95c7.zh: 有人量过，佛蒙特街其实更弯：弯曲度 1.56 比 1.2！
w5-a-c3fe95c7.en: Someone measured it: Vermont Street is curvier — 1.56 to 1.2!

w5-a-7f1eaa1c.zh: 佛蒙特街只有 7 个弯，却被量出比九曲花街还弯！
w5-a-7f1eaa1c.en: Only seven bends, yet measured curvier than Lombard!

w5-a-774352f1.zh: 两条都开过啦！论弯，佛蒙特街赢；论花，九曲花街赢～
w5-a-774352f1.en: Both done! Vermont wins on bends, Lombard on flowers!

w5-a-f394a25d.zh: 点一下地面，扔到那儿！我去接～
w5-a-f394a25d.en: Tap the ground to throw — I’ll fetch!

w5-a-d4a250de.zh: 扔到那边就捡不回来啦，换个地方～
w5-a-d4a250de.en: Can’t fetch it from there — pick another spot!

w5-a-dac00abb.en: That was fun! Throw some more any time!

w5-a-60c324fe.zh: 金门大桥金圈！绕着两座桥塔飞～
w5-a-60c324fe.en: Golden Gate rings! Round both towers!

w5-a-471a2270.zh: 桥塔比海面高 227 米，1937 年就通车啦！
w5-a-471a2270.en: The towers stand 227 m over the water — open since 1937!

w5-a-bf57e7df.zh: 大桥这种橙色，名字叫“国际橙”！
w5-a-bf57e7df.en: That orange has a name: International Orange!

w5-a-80ad9d1b.zh: 骑上鹈鹕飞到大桥边，有金圈等你！
w5-a-80ad9d1b.en: Glide out to the bridge — there are rings!

w5-a-05f0c830.zh: 跟着我喊：嘿——咻！咻的时候推！
w5-a-05f0c830.en: Shout with me: heave — ho! Push on the "ho"!

w5-a-ebed5c01.zh: 叮当车终点的转盘是人力推的，车就这样掉头！
w5-a-ebed5c01.en: The cable-car turntables are pushed by hand — that’s how the cars turn!

w5-a-910cdcd4.zh: 三个转盘都推过啦！盖个章～
w5-a-910cdcd4.en: All three turntables pushed! A stamp for you!

w5-a-c44fdeb8.en: Let’s play hide and seek in a bit!

w5-a-5da58c2c.zh: 这里没地方藏～换个地方再玩吧！
w5-a-5da58c2c.en: Nowhere to hide here. Let’s try somewhere else!

w5-a-af138c00.zh: 我在这儿呢～下次再来找我！
w5-a-af138c00.en: Here I am! Find me next time!

w5-a-70995063.zh: 闭上眼睛数三下，我去藏好！
w5-a-70995063.en: Close your eyes and count to three!

w5-a-5aa34332.zh: 捉迷藏！你数到三，我去藏好～
w5-a-5aa34332.en: Hide and seek! You count to three, I’ll hide!

w5-a-3122a12b.zh: 想玩捉迷藏吗？点「问 BAYBAY」，再点「捉迷藏」！
w5-a-3122a12b.en: Fancy hide and seek? Tap Ask, then Hide & seek!

w5-a-06e95089.zh: 想玩捉迷藏吗？按 Q 问我，再选「捉迷藏」！
w5-a-06e95089.en: Fancy hide and seek? Press Q to ask me, then Hide & seek!

w5-a-5c7f6bf0.zh: 一只、两只……一起数数有几只海狮！
w5-a-5c7f6bf0.en: One, two… let’s count the sea lions!

w5-a-b5aa19f9.en: Every one of them — none missed!

w5-a-c9a06a9a.zh: 这些海狮 1990 年起就在 K 码头安家啦！
w5-a-c9a06a9a.en: These sea lions have lived on K-Dock since 1990!

w5-a-931ea3e1.zh: 最多的时候来过 2100 多只呢——2024 年 5、6 月！
w5-a-931ea3e1.en: The record: over 2,100 of them, in May–June 2024!

w5-a-420d6131.en: What a slide! This grass is slippery!

w5-a-c47f65e8.zh: 里昂街台阶大约 300 级，一路修剪整齐的树篱，正对着艺术宫！
w5-a-c47f65e8.en: The Lyon Street Steps: about 300 of them, neat hedges, and the Palace of Fine Arts dead ahead!

w5-a-6c4f2c8f.zh: 车要掉头啦！跟着我喊：嘿——咻！
w5-a-6c4f2c8f.en: The car’s turning! Shout with me: heave — ho!

w5-a-161fb877.zh: 前面坡顶插着小旗，开快点冲过去能飞起来！
w5-a-161fb877.en: Pennants on the crest ahead — go fast and we’ll fly!

w5-a-d811134b.zh: 看，K 码头上好多海狮！数数有几只？
w5-a-d811134b.en: Look at all the sea lions on K-Dock! Shall we count them?

w5-d-11b086d4.zh: 1989 年秋天起，海狮陆续搬到这片浮台上来了。
w5-d-11b086d4.en: From the autumn of 1989 the sea lions began moving onto these docks.
